items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: No, the only guitar man I played with was Lil Durfee. Durfee, that's years ago. I played with a little man. His brother played clarinet, he played guitar... Frank was clarinet.

ctx.x: What's his brother's name? Durfee, Frank Durfee. Frank Durfee is a guitar player? And which, wait a minute, I can't get this straight.

I can't remember whether Frank, no, Frank's brother played guitar. Frank was clarinet. I forget his brother's name. I can't remember. That's been many years ago. That's when I first started. I did. That's when we used to play Fireman's Hole over in Wiggle.
Yeah, we were just talking to Lil Armstrong about that. That's right.
